visual_species: Puntigrus cf. tetrazona ornamental tiger-barb visual study

references.license: CC BY-SA 2.5; reference only, no image pixels redistributed
references.observed: Actual ornamental tiger barb with deep silver-gold body, four dark vertical head/body bars, triangular dark dorsal with warm tip, orange pelvic fins and pale forked caudal.

limitations: Original ornamental tiger-barb visual study based on the inspected Andre Karwath photograph labelled Puntius tetrazona. The Puntigrus identification remains qualified; minute mouth appendages and fine ray counts are not resolved from this photo. Swimming is artist-tuned.
